sources.title: README.md · jaredpalmer/kev-0.8b at main - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Kev-0.8B is a decision model: one document (the state) and a set of typed questions in, a probability distribution per question out, in one forward pass. No text generation. It is a LoRA adapter (r=16, 11.3M trainable parameters) plus a pointer head on Qwen/Qwen3.5-.8B-Base (revision dc7cdfe2), serving TypeSafe's public /v1/systemone contract.

sources.title: Kev 0.8B: Local VRAM and Hardware Fit - madebyagents.com
sources.snippet: A situational .8B-parameter dense decision model from Jared Palmer. Treat the modality benchmarks above as the leading indicator of fit — composite scoring across modalities is still maturing. Newly released, so production-readiness is still being shaken out.
